definition: App responsiveness or availability prevents or degrades use
include_when: Lag freeze crash or black screen during general app use
exclude_when: Slow human approval or a specific data freshness complaint without app failure

definition: Layout or navigation makes tasks difficult without an explicit transaction failure
include_when: Clutter confusing controls repeated navigation or layout issues
exclude_when: A specific failed order or merely slow app response

definition: Creating a new account or initial identity verification fails or stalls
include_when: Registration face verification initial KYC and initial digital signature when stated
exclude_when: Updating an existing account profile or logging in later

definition: Access to an existing account or login authentication fails or stalls
include_when: Login OTP iOTP biometric login device authorization
exclude_when: Initial KYC face verification for registration

definition: Placing modifying cancelling confirming or executing an order fails or is impaired
include_when: Blocked sell order lost order entry order status and direct order-entry context
exclude_when: General navigation problems without a stated order impact

definition: Moving or making funds available fails or is delayed
include_when: Deposit not credited blocked withdrawal bank-linking or fund validation
exclude_when: Account balance missing only from a display without confirmed movement failure

definition: User cannot obtain timely useful help from support
include_when: Unreachable slow scripted or irrelevant support after contact
exclude_when: An app error with no support interaction

definition: Market price board or quote information is missing stale or unusable
include_when: Missing bid ask or ceiling floor and delayed or frozen price data
exclude_when: Portfolio account balance or investment research recommendations

definition: Held positions balances profit loss or chart state is missing confusing or inconsistent
include_when: Portfolio P and L missing balance display or unsaved chart settings
exclude_when: Price-board quote freshness or actual uncredited deposit

definition: Costs or financing terms create an unmet need or complaint
include_when: Interest fee level fee clarity or pricing conditions
exclude_when: Low fees mentioned only as praise or backdrop to another failure

definition: Existing-account recovery or identity contact update is delayed or blocked
include_when: Phone change recovery identity update or rejection appeal
exclude_when: Initial registration KYC and ordinary existing-account login

definition: Reported security or protection design creates a distinct user concern
include_when: Explicit concern about paid security or protection constraints
exclude_when: OTP delivery fault without a security-design concern

definition: Expected transaction messages are late missing or disruptive
include_when: Delayed transaction email or an explicit communication failure
exclude_when: A routine email received as expected or merely slow market prices

definition: User questions usefulness of market analysis or research
include_when: Explicit complaint about research content utility
exclude_when: Price feed lag or market movement alone as proof of an error

definition: App usage consumes unexpectedly large mobile data according to user
include_when: Concrete mobile data usage per app launch
exclude_when: Slow loading with no reported data consumption
